data_quality_notes.market_share_percentages: Market share figures for individual vendors (Nokia ~20%, Ericsson ~18%, Huawei ~15%, Microsoft ~12%, Amdocs ~8%) are estimates derived from network equipment vendor competitive positioning and market analyst commentary, NOT from a single primary market share report. They are marked [est.] in the trend data and should be verified against a Gartner or IDC vendor share report before publication.
data_quality_notes.search_volume: ~60,000/mo is an estimate for 'AI in telecommunications' and related terms. Exact figure requires Google Keyword Planner verification.
data_quality_notes.growth_5y: +415% calculated from ~$1.17B estimated 2021 market (back-calculated from 2025 figure at 41.9% CAGR) to $6.69B in 2026. The 2021 base figure is an estimate — not sourced from a primary 2021 market report.
data_quality_notes.growth_3m: +35% adoption refers to telecom industry AI adoption rate increase from 49% (2025) to 66% (2026), sourced from HTEC. This is an annual metric presented as the best available 3-month proxy.
data_quality_notes.fraud_savings: $5B+ annual fraud savings figure is widely cited across industry sources (CFCA, GSMA) but precise attribution varies across reports. Mark as [corroborated, not single-source verified].
